meta.title: ScoutiKoora: AI football scouting
meta.description: Find who plays like your target, who fits your budget and who is undervalued. 4,817 players across the Big 5 leagues.

desk.topTalentNote: Ranked by the XGBoost talent score (0–100), players with 1,500+ minutes
desk.hiddenGemsNote: High talent score, market value under €15M, age 26 or under

actions.signInToSave: Sign in to save players and build lists.

report.radarNote: Per-90 stats on a 0–100 scale, where 100 is the top 1% of the Big 5
report.riskUnknown: Risk not rated: days missed weren’t captured for this player.
report.similarNote: KNN cosine similarity on 15 per-90 features, same position
report.notFound: No player called “{name}” in the database. Coverage is the Big 5 leagues, seasons ⁦2020–25⁩.
report.valueZero: No goals or assists this season, so output per €1M is zero.

verdictText.ELITE PROSPECT: High priority target. Top 10% for the position with room to grow.
verdictText.STRONG RECOMMENDATION: Top 25% for the position with a strong talent score. Consider for recruitment.
verdictText.VALUE BUY: Above median for the position at a low price. Undervalued relative to output.
verdictText.VETERAN OPTION: Experienced and top 25% for the position. A short-term option for immediate impact.
verdictText.CAUTION: Elevated risk factors. Scout further before deciding.
verdictText.LIMITED DATA: Under 450 minutes this season, so the scores aren’t reliable yet.
